answer: Each submission hangs on the prism of a task receipt, and the basalt is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the lotus of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
